_om: Ringen in English (Ringleader, rusj.no/en/ringleader/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The rules of the cards and the ideas are in data.en/kort.json. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.

Trekk et kort fra ringen. {n} kort igjen.one: Draw a card from the ring. {n} card left, {konger} of 4 kings drawn.
Trekk et kort fra ringen. {n} kort igjen.other: Draw a card from the ring. {n} cards left, {konger} of 4 kings drawn.

Trykk på et kort i ringen – eller på kna: Tap a card in the ring – or the button.
Skriv regelen – mobilen husker den: Type the rule – the phone remembers it
Kortene ligger i en ring. Dere trekker e: The cards lie in a ring. You take turns to draw, and every card has its own rule. Small sips only – and alcohol-free counts just as much.
Den som har tur, trykker på et kort i ri: Whoever's turn it is taps a card in the ring. The phone shows the rule.
Les regelen høyt og gjør det sammen. En: Read the rule out loud and do it together. A sip is a small sip of whatever you're drinking – water and soft drinks count just as much.
Hver konge legger til en skål. Den som t: Every king adds a toast. Whoever draws the fourth king is crowned and leads the toast for everyone.
Alle kan stå over – helt uten forklaring: Anyone can sit a round out – no explanation needed.
Etter hvert tolvte kort er det vannpause: After every twelfth card, everyone has a water break.
Roller som tommelmester gjelder til nest: Roles like thumb master last until the next card of the same value. Tap ‘In play’ to see who has what.
Skriv inn regler og skåler, så husker mo: Type in rules and toasts, and the phone remembers them for the finale.
Spis og drikk vann underveis, og sørg fo: Eat and drink water as you go, and make sure everyone gets home safely.
Draw a card from the ring.
Every card has its own rule.
Sett dere i ring i samme rekkefølge som: Sit in a ring in the same order as the list. Play passes to the left.
A sip is a small sip – never more.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye, og alle ka: Alcohol-free counts just as much, and anyone can sit a round out.
Etter hvert tolvte kort tar alle en vann: After every twelfth card, everyone has a water break.
Alkoholfritt teller like mye · alle kan: Alcohol-free counts too · anyone can sit out
Alle tar en god slurk vann før neste kor: Everyone has a good sip of water before the next card. Your body will thank you – and the night lasts longer.
Dere tok finalen etter {kort}. Skål for: You took the finale after {kort}. Cheers to the crew – and thanks for a great night!
Ringen er brutt etter {kort}. Skål for g: The ring is broken after {kort}. Cheers to the crew – and thanks for a great night!
Remember water, food and a safe way home.
You drink together until the next eight.
Laget av {navn} · gjelder resten av spil: Made by {navn} · lasts for the rest of the game
You can always start a new ring.
Ta finalen nå, så skåler dere for skålen: Take the finale now: you drink to the toasts you've made and crown a king. Or quit without a finale.
Ta finalen nå, så skåler dere for gjenge: Take the finale now: you drink to the crew and crown a king. Or quit without a finale.
